stories.title: "New cat alert!": the first new cat species in over 100 years
stories.summary: National Geographic announced that a wildlife sanctuary's call about a "weird cat" led to the first new cat species discovered in over 100 years, the tilcayo, found in Bolivia's Yungas forest. The post got 377K likes, "NEW CAT DROPPED I REPEAT NEW CAT DROPPED THIS IS NOT A DRILL ITS IN FACT A CAT" got 243K, and NatGeo's follow-up photos got 167K.
